review.note: The complete project source is public at the repository above and every release is tagged v<version>; the release packager also ships a sources tarball, NOTICES and this resolved inventory next to each DMG. This block does not gate a release. The items below are open review points about third-party component materials, kept for follow-up.
open_items: No whole-app binary/static dependency closure review or responsible release approval exists.
Audited bundled FFmpeg reports GPL version 3 or later: resolve whole-combination GPLv3 distribution terms, full texts, exact FFmpeg sources/build configuration and transitive codec sources.
Qt 6.11.1 exact module sources, third-party notices, patches, configure options and recipient replacement/relinking materials are incomplete.
Official GStreamer 1.28.3 Cerbero recipes/patches and all exact transitive sources still need collection; SDK notices lack a separate gst-plugins-good directory.
rswebrtc 0.15.2 source archive and MPL notice verified, but Cargo static dependency sources/notices and build-tool inputs remain incomplete.
OBS dependency bundle, Sparkle, fonts/assets, static libraries, codecs and Blackmagic SDK redistribution/source obligations need exact-payload review.
Review modifications/dates, required submodules versus disabled-platform exclusions, build/install instructions, installation information and codec/patent/vendor obligations.
